studionet.notes: v9 — Phase 3 Watchtower bundle. Community bounty (fund_bounty payable, anyone can top up; contributors listed on-chain), suspect watchlist (owner add_watchlist_url up to 20; scans on watchlisted URLs earn 2x tier bounty share, capped by pool), on-chain takedown notice registry (issue_takedown_notice after INFRINGEMENT survives 25-epoch appeal grace; idempotent; stores full evidence bundle keyed by verdict_key). New views: list_bounty_contributors, list_watchlist, is_on_watchlist, get_takedown_notice, takedown_ready. See CHANGELOG.md 2026-09-14 section.
